item.title: Silicon qubits surpass 99.99% gate fidelity while operating three at once
item.description: Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform for building scalable quantum computers as they are compatible with the semiconductor manufacturing technologies used to produce today's computer chips. However, they have an important weakness: silicon spin qubits typically lose accuracy when several qubits are under parallel control. To be useful, quantum computers will need to operate many qubits simultaneously without compromising the accuracy of their operations. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Elvis Presley’s former Beverly Hills home sells for $25.5 million after decades of renovations
item.description: In 1967, Elvis and Priscilla Presley acquired an opulent home in Beverly Hills' Trousdale Estates for $400,000. Their tenure at the estate lasted until 1973, marking the period when their daughter Lisa Marie was born. After significant renovations, the property was sold in 2019 for an impressive $25.5 million, showcasing the lasting allure of celebrity residences and the historic value they carry. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
